application_credentials.description:
To link your Tibber account you need an OAuth2 client. To register one, please follow these steps.

1. Go to the [Tibber client registration page]({client_registration_url}) and log in with your Tibber account.
1. Create a new client.
1. Under scopes, select at least `data-api-homes-read` and `data-api-vehicles-read`.
1. Fill in `{redirect_url}` as the redirect URI. This works even if your Home Assistant instance has no public URL — see this integration's `docs/DECISIONS.md` for why.
1. Fill in the client ID and secret that are now shown (the secret is only shown once).
